== Summary ==
[[Robbie Hendon]] (7th place) with his crystal award in front of the Players Committee banner. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).

'''Identification:''' Identified by matching the [[:File:2021 World Championship Top 8.jpg]] group photo (front row, right; wrap-up caption): same green Dallas Stars cap, face and goatee.

* '''Event:''' [[2021 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2021-10-31
